category_title: Students with blindness and autism exhibiting executive functioning deficits and low task independence
scenario_title: Introduction of New Activities and Generalization
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small group music session and is asked to try playing a new rhythm on a drum.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Today we are going to try a new music activity with the group. Instead of our usual song, I want you to try playing this new rhythm on the drum.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to try the new rhythm. I am happy doing what I am used to doing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give the new rhythm a try with the rest of the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hits the drum off-beat) That was wrong. It did not turn out as expected.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It's fine, just keep playing along with us.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I am very worried. The mistake needs to be corrected immediately. I am unable to think about anything else and I will not try this new thing anymore.

task.content: Introduction of new activities or tasks
task.learning_goal: Generalizing skills from one area to another

context.environment: Special school or small group setting

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When asked to try new things or do certain activities
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Very reluctant to try new things, happy doing what they are used to do, displays major difficulties with generalizing skills
related_quotes: Well, [s/he’s] happy doing what [s/he] is used to do, but that doesn’t lead [her/him] forward…

behavior_patterns.condition: When something did not turn out as expected or a mistake is made
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Wants the mistake to be corrected immediately, dwells on it for a long time
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Considerable distress, very worried, unable to think about anything else
related_quotes: …[s/he] gets very worried and wants the mistake to be corrected immediately, otherwise [s/he] dwells on in for a long time, unable to think about anything else
